positional.description: Whether the instruction identified the node by where it sits rather than by what it says. Caching hint only; it never changes what the runner executes. Not required, so a response without it is still valid agent-locate-1, and a runner MUST treat absence as positional rather than defaulting to false (10-determinism.md). A runner's own structured-output request schema SHOULD nonetheless require it: a closed request schema that omits it forbids the model from answering, which leaves every locate unrecordable.

pointTarget.description: Offered only to vision calls; the runner validates and hit-tests the point before any dispatch.
